authored_narrative.episode_purpose: The boiler-room labor from Episode 2 returns a second time — no longer a solitary burden Gonagi carries alone, but work Dana now shares without either of them needing to ask.

scene_spirited_away_no_face_loneliness_0.purpose: The isolation motif appears one last time, briefly, only to be immediately answered — Dana is already there before the loneliness has room to set in.
scene_spirited_away_no_face_loneliness_0.stakes: whether isolation can even register as isolation once it is reliably interrupted
scene_spirited_away_no_face_loneliness_0.opposing_force: the pull of habit — Gonagi still braces for solitude out of old reflex, even though it no longer arrives

scene_spirited_away_boiler_room_0029.purpose: The exhausting labor of Episode 2 is echoed here as shared work — the same room, the same task, but carried by two rather than endured by one.
scene_spirited_away_boiler_room_0029.stakes: whether shared labor changes the work itself or only who feels its weight
scene_spirited_away_boiler_room_0029.opposing_force: the boiler room's own indifferent scale, large enough that it barely notices the difference between one worker and two

shot_spirited_00217.intent: A two-shot where earlier isolation scenes used negative space around a single figure — the frame itself now assumes company as the default.

shot_spirited_00225.intent: A direct echo of shot 00033 (Episode 2's original boiler-room framing), but widened just enough to hold two figures working in the same rhythm.
